<function name="IsNoDraw" parent="SurfaceInfo" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Checks if the brush surface is a nodraw surface, meaning it will not be drawn by the engine.

<note>This internally checks the SURFDRAW_NODRAW flag.</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Returns true if this surface won't be drawn.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
